policy.train: Cases whose parsed alarm month is 2025-06 through 2025-09 inclusive, combined across both sources.
policy.test: All remaining months, kept in two source-specific test directories because endpoint naming and lane profiles differ.
policy.labels: Normalize l1/l3 to L1 (local), l2/l4 to L2 (remote), and preserve fiber; exact expert annotations are applied before normalization.
policy.experiments: No model fitting or evaluation is performed by this preparation script.

topology_contract.policy: Same-index optical lanes are logical pairs defined by the source telemetry contract. They may be used for categorical and within-case relative evidence, never for absolute link loss. SerDes lanes are not paired to optical lanes.
